hook_text: Before you visit this telescope, you have to switch off your phone. Why?
clip_script: Carnarvon, in the Karoo. Phones off! Ahead: sixty-four giant dishes, all pointing at one spot in the sky. This is MeerKAT. It listens to radio waves from space, so faint that one phone could drown them out. Next stop, Sutherland: a silver dome hiding SALT, with a mirror of ninety-one pieces, about eleven metres wide. And soon, the SKA, the biggest radio telescope on Earth. Built right here in South Africa!
visual_style: Whiteboard Karoo landscape with rows of dishes, a phone with a cross through it, and a big silver dome on a hill.
mood: Proud and amazed, a road trip with a big surprise.
pacing: Phones off, the dishes reveal, then the dome, then the future.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find Sutherland and Carnarvon on a map.
